versions.changelog:
wechat-search 1.0.0

- Initial release of the 微信搜一搜实时搜索工具 for searching real-time WeChat content (articles, videos, images).
- Supports real-time, authoritative searches from the WeChat ecosystem without requiring a WeChat account.
- Requires Node.js environment and GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for access.
- Compatible with Windows, Mac, and Linux platforms.
- Outputs search logs automatically for data reuse.
